entries.title: Psalms 88:1
segments: ¶<<A Song [or] Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.>> O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day [and] night before thee: {for the sons: or, of the sons} {Maschil...: or, A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction}

words.text: before thee: {for the sons: or, of the sons} {Maschil...: or, A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction}

entries.title: Psalms 88:2
segments: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

entries.title: Psalms 88:3
segments: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

entries.title: Psalms 88:4
segments: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man [that hath] no strength:

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
segments: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand. {from: or, by}

words.text: no more: and they are cut off

entries.title: Psalms 88:6
segments: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
segments: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted [me] with all thy waves. Selah.

words.text: upon me, and thou hast afflicted

entries.title: Psalms 88:8
segments: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: [I am] shut up, and I cannot come forth.

entries.title: Psalms 88:9
segments: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

words.text: upon thee, I have stretched out

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
segments: ¶Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise [and] praise thee? Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 88:11
segments: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? [or] thy faithfulness in destruction?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
segments: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
segments: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

words.text: But unto thee have I cried

entries.title: Psalms 88:14
segments: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? [why] hidest thou thy face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 88:15
segments: I [am] afflicted and ready to die from [my] youth up: [while] I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

entries.title: Psalms 88:16
segments: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
segments: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together. {daily: or, all the day}

entries.title: Psalms 88:18
segments: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, [and] mine acquaintance into darkness.
